kind: fold of experiments/2026-11-24/mb-zero-reference-pass (#160): a paper-strict zero-reference reading beside the inclusive one; not a new experiment and not a reproduction
code_note: the module is adapted from this lab's own #160 code (no paper code exists); it does not import the #160 folder
text_copied: short attributed quotes only: the paper's two strict inequalities in the README and author-reported figures from the abstract under on_unmeasured (fragments of up to about 14 words, CC BY 4.0)

source.citation_title: What Does Matching a Human Intervention Effect Establish? Benchmark Checks for LLM Simulations
source.authors_as_listed: Tengfei Shao, Asma Rezaei, Ali Reza Kamali
source.repository: none listed on the abstract page

declared_rule.equivalence: inclusive, unchanged from #160: human_hi - m <= candidate <= human_lo + m
declared_rule.critical_value: T = max(|human_lo|, |human_hi|); under the strict rule no least passing margin exists, so T is the infimum, not a smallest margin
declared_rule.zero_reference_inclusive: passes when T <= m (#160 reading; drives the verdict and the planted gate)
declared_rule.zero_reference_paper_strict: passes only when T < m (the paper's condition (1) is strict); reported beside the inclusive reading on every row
declared_rule.at_m_equal_T: inclusive PASS, paper-strict FAIL (fixture more.json zero_on_edge)
declared_rule.numbers: exact decimals: at most 32 characters, |value| <= 100 compared with copy_abs() before any rounding, at most 30 decimal places, no positive exponent (so 0E+999999999 is DENY bad_number), rule at 80 significant digits

measured.note: counts of hand-made planted contrasts, not rates

on_unmeasured.what: author-reported: in an exploratory 70-experiment reanalysis, 72 percent of GPT-4's passes at a +-0.20 SD margin were zero-reference passes
author-reported: GPT-4 passed 16 contrasts the zero reference failed, against 1.58 expected without a response
author-reported: when the zero reference fails, planned precision gives the margin up to which passing is a 5 percent test of response; no such margin is computed here

author-reported preregistered audit: three intention targets passed, all zero-reference passes, plus the registered belief-gradient control; norm beliefs changed 0.065 SD against the human 0.351 SD (zero-reference check added after unblinding)
author-reported: registered tests detected no overestimation; average-effect intervals excluded overestimation above 0.08 SD
author-reported: a group audit's precision floor of 1.33 facts against a 2.9-fact effect

the paper's own TOST statistics (bH, SEH, E, SEE) are not computed; the fixtures give only [human_lo, human_hi] and m, and T = max(|human_lo|, |human_hi|) equals |bH| + 1.645 SEH only for a symmetric 90 percent interval
the PDF line numbers l.254 and l.260 for the two strict inequalities come from the review's pdftotext extraction; the PDF was not opened for this fold
candidate effects are point estimates here; candidate intervals and sampling error are not modelled
any real study, simulation or model output; all contrasts are synthetic
